dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network: six Nb chain sites, distinct Ga 1b and Sb 1a roles
candidate.prototype_evidence: Pm-3 ordered A15-derived eight-site network: six Nb chain sites, distinct Ga 1b and Sb 1a roles
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: The source target path has no signed negative values and Gamma optical compression is positive. Ordered-site entropy, antisite disorder, chain/CDW distortion and Sb SOC are physical competing effects. The target loses to AlNb6Sb at all ten lambda values; that opposite control and its small negative-path risk remain explicit. Different PP paths/code versions across the Rh/Sb comparison are not concealed and the response is not geometry-only causal.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.022252643 eV/A, P=0.051 GPa, full max stress=0.051 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Sb replaces Rh on its unique ordered site. Volume expands 4.3828%, nearest Nb-Nb grows 0.0758951 A and the Nb-to-replaced-site bond grows 0.0531240 A. Direct source lambda rises at all ten sigma values by 17.016–52.766% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.014 to 17.221 K. This coupled chain/site construction is measured, not inferred from an A15 name.
candidate.next_action: At the frozen ordered Ga/(Rh or Sb) roles compare a common source method and common volume, then test an antisite/disordered or symmetry-breaking chain competitor. Persistent favorable lambda with stable order supports the bounded candidate; loss under the matched method or a lower unstable ordered branch opposes it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Sb replaces Rh on its unique ordered site. Volume expands 4.3828%, nearest Nb-Nb grows 0.0758951 A and the Nb-to-replaced-site bond grows 0.0531240 A. Direct source lambda rises at all ten sigma values by 17.016–52.766% and separate Eli mu=.1 rises 14.014 to 17.221 K. This coupled chain/site construction is measured, not inferred from an A15 name.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.022252643 eV/A, P=0.051 GPa, full max stress=0.051 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: The source target path has no signed negative values and Gamma optical compression is positive. Ordered-site entropy, antisite disorder, chain/CDW distortion and Sb SOC are physical competing effects. The target loses to AlNb6Sb at all ten lambda values; that opposite control and its small negative-path risk remain explicit. Different PP paths/code versions across the Rh/Sb comparison are not concealed and the response is not geometry-only causal.
seven_criteria.novelty: 1973 primary Nb3Ga experiments included partial Ga replacement by Sb, so Nb-Ga-Sb superconducting chemistry is prior art. They do not establish this exact 1a/1b ordering and relaxed Pm-3 chain structure. Dated exact-formula/ordered-phase searches found no matching experimental superconducting source state; the candidate hypothesis is phase/ordering scoped and new to the reviewed catalogue.
seven_criteria.decision: At the frozen ordered Ga/(Rh or Sb) roles compare a common source method and common volume, then test an antisite/disordered or symmetry-breaking chain competitor. Persistent favorable lambda with stable order supports the bounded candidate; loss under the matched method or a lower unstable ordered branch opposes it.
